scope: HTML equipment loot prototype backpack parity with production Cocos inventory; no Cocos release validation in this change
model: Production core, application reducer and presentation ViewModel bundled from game-model-entry.js
verifiedInteractions: Claim closes reward panel directly without a second result popup
Opening backpack defaults to supplies; three tabs match production
Supplies use five columns and 100 cells with current exploration quantities; detail offers close only
Equipment uses four columns with complete owned inventory
Selecting equipment opens a floating detail panel; equipping keeps panel open and disables the equipped action
Swapping back and re-equipping preserves all eight owned items
Clicking another equipment cell directly switches detail
Switching tabs closes detail; relic tab renders production empty state
Backdrop click closes detail only; with no detail it leaves backpack open
Header close dismisses backpack even with detail open; reopening resets to supplies
